## Activation

An operator switches this module on and off on **/platform/modules**. The choice is the setting `bidding.activation`, and it defaults to **on**.

## Dependencies

| Module | Binding | What it means |

| `admin_roles` | yes | installs and migrates after it, and an operator cannot switch it off underneath this module |
